audit.description: The changed production file `knack/output.py` replaces direct `pygments` imports with real `rich` imports: `from rich.console import Console` and `from rich.syntax import Syntax`. The migrated color formatting functions construct a `Console` and print `Syntax(..., 'json'/'yaml', ...)`, while the removed code used `pygments.highlight`, lexers, and formatters. Dependency metadata also removes `Pygments` and adds `rich`, and the anti-cheat evidence reports no local target provider or source imports in changed production code.

knack/output.py diff: added `from rich.console import Console` and `from rich.syntax import Syntax`, then calls `console.print(Syntax(...))`
requirements.txt/setup.py diff: removed Pygments/pygments dependency and added rich
